name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: API key. Leave unset to read it from the variable named in apiKeyEnv.

apiKeyEnv.title: API key variable
apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable that holds the API key: TYPESAFE_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY or OPENCODE_API_KEY.

baseUrl.title: System One endpoint
baseUrl.description: System One endpoint URL: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/systemone or https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/systemone.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

autoAction.title: Automatic action
autoAction.description: What happens when the context reaches compactAtPercent: compact (/compact), handoff (/jev-handoff) or off.

trigger.title: Automatic trigger
trigger.description: percent: act only at compactAtPercent. cost: also act as soon as pruning is cheaper than keeping the context (compactAtPercent stays as the ceiling).

inputPricePerMTok.title: Input price (USD per 1M tokens)
inputPricePerMTok.description: Base input price of your model, used by the cost check.

cacheReadMultiplier.title: Cache read multiplier
cacheReadMultiplier.description: Price of a cache read as a multiple of the base input price.

cacheWriteMultiplier.title: Cache write multiplier
cacheWriteMultiplier.description: Price of a cache write as a multiple of the base input price: 1.25 for the 5-minute TTL, 2 for 1 hour.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: Minutes after which an idle prompt cache expires.

jevCostUsd.title: Jev run cost (USD)
jevCostUsd.description: Your estimate of what one Jev pruning run costs.

expectedTurns.title: Expected turns
expectedTurns.description: Turns you expect to do in the session after now; the cost check compares the two options over this many turns.

assumedKeepRatio.title: Assumed keep ratio
assumedKeepRatio.description: Fraction of the context that a prune keeps, until one prune of the session measured it.

minSavingUsd.title: Minimum saving (USD)
minSavingUsd.description: The cost trigger needs at least this saving over expectedTurns.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.
